reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 15. Nay or No: 4. Not Voting: 21. Of 19 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 19 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 213 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

running.label: Candidates who filed with the FEC for this seat. Filing is not the same as being on the ballot. Primary results and ballot access are not shown.

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.
donor_industry.cycle_rule: House filings use the 2026 two-year cycle.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.
stands_for.factual_flag: Not yet summarized: this line is built only from the official vote question and the bill's official title.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

This Veterans Day, join me in honoring the courage and sacrifice of all those who have proudly served our great nation.

We are the land of the free because of the brave. Thank you, veterans! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/0CcB1rJCp9

For years, I've worked to expose the Obama/Biden-era "birth tourism" loophole that let Chinese citizens enter America's CNMI without a visa.

Glad DHS is slamming it shut. https://t.co/x4gVXS3Zux

Our number one priority is to protect American citizens.

The Stop Greenlighting Driver Licenses for Illegal Immigrants Act would put an end to this insanity. https://t.co/4SpCMcNszq

🚨Title IX protections will now be based on sex, NOT “gender identity.”

This is a major victory for female athletes across the United States who deserve a fair and level playing field.

Common sense is returning. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/6xPzcufnik

Importing foreign welfare recipients and sticking hardworking Americans with the bill is crazy.

Making those same taxpayers pay for a lawsuit to defend it?

Even crazier. https://t.co/PictFhcbmu

The thing Democrats and the mainstream media insist never happens has happened… again.

An illegal alien was charged with voting in Wisconsin.

The Senate must pass the SAVE America Act and require Voter ID and proof of citizenship to protect our elections. https://t.co/IJODHlqqJE

The gray wolf has recovered. Farmers are dealing with livestock depredations, families are losing pets, and wolves are showing up closer to homes.

Wisconsin knows how to successfully manage its wildlife. It’s time to let states responsibly manage their wolf populations. https://t.co/UexekaJhdP

Glad to see @SecDuffy pumping the brakes on “trucking schools” certifying CDLs for foreigners, including three in Wisconsin.

When aliens who can't speak or read English are behind the wheel, it puts us all at risk. https://t.co/wCtjnpPwxU

Hmm… why would they want to stop this?

Maybe because they want taxpayer-funded benefits going to foreigners.

In Wisconsin, our Democrat governor vetoed legislation that would have blocked your tax dollars from paying for "free" health care for illegal immigrants. https://t.co/J7CVPbH7zq
You’d know, since you just took a summer trip to visit one of those systems and meet with its dictator, right, Mark? https://t.co/0WGonYnowN https://t.co/KCncMR3fsX

Great to join the Hmong Wausau Festival this past weekend.

It was a wonderful celebration of culture and the many contributions Wisconsin’s Hmong community makes to our state. https://t.co/bgYx2Sp0Mf

“That’s already illegal” isn’t an argument that it can’t happen.

New Jersey’s Democrat governor admitted today that roughly 6,600 foreigners registered to vote and about 400 cast ballots. https://t.co/c3IauVsRBy

First, Democrats and the media said it wasn’t happening.

Now they admit it’s happening, but insist it’s no big deal that 6,600 non-citizens were registered to vote in New Jersey and roughly 400 cast ballots.

Deny. Downplay. Repeat.

We need the SAVE America Act now. https://t.co/eTT44OS3oY

For 14 straight months, the Trump administration has released zero illegal aliens into our country.

A secure border means a safer America. https://t.co/US69lUFbSS

The T stands for temporary.

Temporary things end.

That's what makes them temporary. https://t.co/vTPctck9yi

I introduced the OMAR Act to stop members of Congress and federal candidates from funneling campaign funds to their spouses.

This is a ridiculous loophole that politicians use to enrich their families, and Cori Bush has done it for years. https://t.co/T8xklBqShz
We cannot prevent every wildfire, but we can reduce their severity through responsible, science-based forest management. Healthy forests are good for our environment, our economy, and public health.

We see this firsthand in @NatResources.

Too often, in both the United States and Canada, active forest management has been sidelined by green lobby policies that lock up forests, allow dangerous fuel to accumulate, and increase the risk of larger, more destructive wildfires.

🧵An Air Quality Advisory is once again in effect across Wisconsin as smoke from wildfires in northern Minnesota and Canada drifts into our state.

While dry conditions certainly play a role, decades of fuel buildup in overgrown forests have made these fires more severe. https://t.co/08dGuL5Ps2

Someone might want to tell Senator Baldwin that voter ID has been the law in Wisconsin for years.

And 71% of Wisconsin voters approved a constitutional amendment stating that only U.S. citizens are eligible to vote in our elections. https://t.co/81VJZplhEW

This is what TDS looks like.

Tim Walz’s Clemency Review Commission was so determined to stop a deportation that they pardoned a convicted child rapist and actually argued he should be with his six children.

Thankfully, the Trump administration stepped in and deported him. https://t.co/BMiQefwACP

A jury found Hannah Dugan GUILTY of felony obstruction for helping an illegal alien with a violent criminal history, including strangulation and domestic abuse, evade federal authorities.

A $5,000 fine is a slap on the wrist. A liberal judge failed to deliver justice. https://t.co/y0O1sN74AS

The American experiment has endured for 250 years because each generation accepted the responsibility of preserving liberty for the next.

Happy 250th birthday, America. 🇺🇸🦅 https://t.co/4IqVvaTmBe

On the eve of America’s 250th birthday, I’m especially grateful to call Wisconsin home.

Our state has helped feed America, power its industries, and defend its freedoms. Wisconsin will help lead our nation into its next 250 years. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/nsxZTRgWCP

After years of fighting for this in Congress, we finally got it done.

American taxpayers should not be forced to bankroll unreliable energy projects.

Our farmland is one of our greatest resources. We must protect it and our food supply for generations to come. https://t.co/DVSwLMMzGD

📺WATCH: Sheridan Gorman's mother sent her daughter to Chicago believing she would be safe.

Instead, she was murdered by an illegal alien who had previously been arrested & later released in a sanctuary jurisdiction.

For every American's safety, we must END sanctuary policies. https://t.co/dSPbTzgIOA

The Supreme Court’s misguided ruling today ignores the original intent of the Citizenship Clause and its authors by granting automatic citizenship to the children of illegal invaders and foreign birth tourists.

Congress must act to restore America’s sovereignty. https://t.co/QYkO9CAVvZ

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
